text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
My... ab-so-lute... vic-to-ry! Behold, 
world! This is the power of the future 
Overlord of the End of the Century!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
With this, Doto's resolve was set. Not as 
enemies... but as ones who elevate each 
other. She wanted to become her "lifelong 
rival"!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Rivals—they, too, are essential to a 
champion. All to build the strength needed 
to defeat the Golden Generation! ...Now, 
the stage is set.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Toward the final battleground where the 
"Golden Generation" awaits... To the Arima 
Kinen—!
